parties.respondent: Rameshwar @ Ramesh Chandra Sharma (Dead) through Legal Heir & Anr.

summary: The case involved appeals by NOIDA against the Allahabad High Court's decision to condone a 22-year delay in filing appeals by landowners and enhancing compensation to Rs.149 per sq.yard, consistent with Deo Karan & Ors. While the Court upheld the enhanced compensation and condonation of delay, it held that the acquiring body should not bear the burden of statutory benefits and interest under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for the 22-year delay, as it would impose significant financial strain. The appeals were partly allowed to exclude such benefits and interest.
legal_provisions_cited: New Okhla Industrial Development Authority v. Deo Karan & Ors. (2018)
Nanak (Deceased) through LRS. v. New Okhla Industrial Development Authority (2018)
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; High Court's order modified to exclude statutory benefits and interest for the delayed period; no order as to costs.
